fusions.name: Torpid Hiss
fusions.desc: A cold hiss that deals 3 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Enervated] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bite and Wait
fusions.desc: A venomous bite that deals 25 damage, ignoring resistance, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Regrown Tail
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 5%.
